dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Identification of five prominent 'O'-shaped structures with sharply defined, high-intensity white perimeters. The central cluster of three annuli exhibits an abrupt gradient transition from bright exterior perimeters to dark, low-intensity cores. Two additional distinct structures include a smaller closed 'O' in the posterior-dorsal region and a partially open 'C' shape in the anterior-mid section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Dense spatial concentration of irregular, high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients in the anterior-dorsal quadrant. These clusters are closely packed, whereas similar white features in the posterior region are more dispersed and display lower core pixel intensity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent central annuli form a narrow, nearly vertical triangle. A secondary geometric relationship is defined by the spatial vector connecting the centroid of the largest central annulus to the centroid of the posterior-dorsal annulus, forming an angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique vertical chain-like alignment of three high-contrast rings situated in the mid-lateral field, providing a high-intensity focal geometric signature that is distinct from the surrounding mottled texture.
